items.description: Diagnostic inspection of the cracked laptop
items.rationale: Policy 5.2.3 covers diagnostic costs for damaged portable insured equipment only if an insured event under 2.6 is established. Here, the swerve and impact are sudden external actions (2.6.1, 2.6.2), and the damage pattern is consistent (2.6.6). However, the battery health is at 79%, below the 80% threshold in 2.6.8, so the unit is not 'portable insured equipment' at the time of loss and 2.6.7 applies: no indemnity for any head, including diagnostics.

items.description: Laptop screen and lower-right corner repair
items.rationale: Although the physical damage is genuine and the event would otherwise be covered (2.6.1, 2.6.2, 2.6.6), the battery health report (photo and text: 79% of design capacity) triggers 2.6.8. The laptop is not 'portable insured equipment' for policy purposes, so 2.6.7 applies: no indemnity for repair, replacement, or any ancillary cost.
